title: AI Dark Fantasy Art Generator
summary: Make dark fantasy art with AI. Describe a grim world, pick a dark fantasy style, and Flick paints cursed knights, ruined cathedrals and swamp creatures.
body_markdown:
### How do I make dark fantasy art with AI?


Describe one figure in a decaying fantasy setting with a single light, such as a knight before a cathedral glowing green in the fog, pick a dark fantasy style, and generate. In Flick you can then animate the still into a clip.


### What colours are used in dark fantasy art?


Dark fantasy art leans on charcoal, black, bone white, cold blue and grey, with accents of dried-blood red, ember orange or a sickly green from a single light source.


### Can I make a dark fantasy video, not just an image?


Yes. Generate the still first, then use it as the start frame of an image to video model in Flick, and describe slow motion that suits the mood, such as fog drifting, ravens circling or a cloak moving in the wind.


### How do I keep the same monster or knight across scenes?


Generate a character sheet with front, side and back views first, then give that sheet as a reference to every later image or video, which keeps the design the same from shot to shot.


### Is the dark fantasy art generator free?


Yes, it is free to start: the free plan gives 100 credits every week with no credit card, and GPT Image 2.6 runs on it. Video models such as Seedance 2.5 need the Standard plan ($20 a month).
